gloss: a part; a portion; a section

definitions.gloss: a part; a portion; a section
definitions.explanation: A fraction or segment of a larger whole. More explicit than 一部, emphasizing that the item in question is literally one section of something.

examples.japanese: これは{全体|ぜんたい}の{一部分|いちぶぶん}にすぎない。
examples.english: This is only a part of the whole.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}の{一部分|いちぶぶん}が{壊|こわ}れていた。
examples.english: A section of the wall was broken.

examples.japanese: {費用|ひよう}の{一部分|いちぶぶん}は{会社|かいしゃ}が{負担|ふたん}してくれるので、{自分|じぶん}で{払|はら}う{金額|きんがく}は{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: The company covers a portion of the cost, so the amount I pay out of pocket is small.

notes:
Composed of {一|いち} (one) + {部分|ぶぶん} (part). While {一部|いちぶ} is the more common and shorter synonym, {一部分|いちぶぶん} is slightly more formal and emphasizes the physical or conceptual segment more concretely.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体|ぜんたい}の{一部分|いちぶぶん}: a part of the whole
- ほんの{一部分|いちぶぶん}: just a small portion
- {一部分|いちぶぶん}だけ: only a portion
- {一部分|いちぶぶん}を{占|し}める: to make up a portion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一部|いちぶ}: a part — more common in everyday speech and writing; often interchangeable
- {部分|ぶぶん}: a part, portion — more general and does not specify "one" section
- {一端|いったん}: one end, a part — emphasizes a glimpse or aspect rather than a physical section
